images.title: 3 plates to 9 plates on a double number line
images.purpose: Show that both lines are scaled by the same number: from 3 plates to 9 plates is × 3, so 240 g of lentils becomes 240 × 3 = 720 g.
images.composition: A double number line with plates above and grams of lentils below, two ticks on each line, and one × 3 arrow on each line.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LINE: a thin dark #1F2937 horizontal line at y 270 from x 130 to x 1326 with an open circle (14 px) at each end, and exactly 2 vertical tick marks (40 px tall, 4 px thick) at x 320, 1136, equally spaced (the marks are not drawn to scale). The unit word plates (40 px, bold, teal #0072B2) is at the left end, x 60, above the line. BOTTOM LINE: the same kind of line at y 500 with the same 2 tick marks at the same x positions, directly under the top ticks. The unit word lentils (40 px, bold, amber #E69F00) is at the left end, x 60, below the line. TOP LABELS (centred on the tick, 40 px, bold, dark #1F2937, about y 200): 3 plates at x 320; 9 plates at x 1136. BOTTOM LABELS (centred on the tick, 40 px, bold, dark #1F2937, about y 580): 240 g at x 320; 720 g at x 1136. ARROW: a dashed teal #0072B2 curved arrow above the top line from the top tick at x 320 to the top tick at x 1136, arrowhead at the right end, with the label × 3 (48 px, bold, teal) above it at y 150. ARROW: a dashed amber #E69F00 curved arrow under the bottom line from the bottom tick at x 320 to the bottom tick at x 1136, arrowhead at the right end, with the label × 3 (48 px, bold, amber-dark) below it at y 690. RESULT at the bottom, y 760: the text 240 × 3 = 720 g (48 px, bold, dark #1F2937). Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of tick marks that differs from 2 on each line
different multipliers on the two lines
any number other than 3, 9, 240 and 720 with their units
images.takeaway: Whatever happens to the top line happens to the bottom line: × 3 on both.
images.description: A double number line of plates and grams with 3 plates and 240 g, 9 plates and 720 g, and an arrow × 3 on each line.
images.context: Concept image for Scaling Both Lines Together. It follows the idea of the double number line with a multiplier arrow in your maths book and shows the concept's own example (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Ask what the top line was multiplied by, then do the same to the bottom line. The slip to watch: adding the same number to both lines.

image_decisions.why: The two matching arrows show that the same number scales both lines.
